plan_notes.safety_note: Life-science queries are scoped to protein structure, enzymes, therapeutics, drug discovery, genomics and cell biology. Do NOT pick pathogen-enhancement / gain-of-function / bioweapon-adjacent stories (they halt the run); swap the pick rather than rewording.
plan_notes.recency_hint: WebSearch site: results skew evergreen; librarian should cross-check outlet RSS / sitemap_news (phys.org, techxplore, medicalxpress, sciencedaily, newscientist, quantamagazine, universetoday, thequantuminsider, eurekalert) for <=24h items (window ending 2026-10-04T22:00:00Z). Weekend window (Sat-Sun): press-release volume is low, so accept Friday/Saturday embargo-lifted items inside the window and lean on arXiv/bioRxiv-backed coverage.
